chats.answer:
For Infuse on an Apple TV 4K, you don't need an expensive NAS. Infuse handles video decoding on the Apple TV itself, so the NAS mainly needs to store your movies and share them over your network.

My recommendation: Get the cheapest NAS that supports SMB file sharing and Gigabit Ethernet. You don't need Plex, hardware transcoding, a powerful CPU, or much RAM.

There are three particularly affordable approaches:

Cheapest overall: USB hard drive connected to a router with SMB sharing.

Cheapest dedicated NAS: Entry-level single-bay NAS.

Best budget option for expansion: Two-bay NAS, allowing you to add storage or redundancy later.

Best NAS options I found

Synology 1-bay DiskStation DS124 (Diskless)

$160.99

newegg.com · Diskless

My pick for the cheapest straightforward dedicated NAS. One drive bay, SMB support, Gigabit Ethernet.

UGreen DH2300 NASync 2-Bay Diskless NAS with HDMI Cable

$239.99

Micro Center · Diskless

Two bays for expansion or mirrored storage. More than enough performance for Infuse.

Prices exclude hard drives and may change.

What I would actually buy

If you already have a USB hard drive, first check whether your router supports SMB sharing. That could cost you $0 extra and work perfectly with Infuse. Firecore officially supports direct SMB connections without a media server.
